labels.reason: The body contains three digitized whole-lung mean concentration records for rabbit SC 2 mg/kg, with marker labels, sampling-time fields, pixel coordinates and SOURCE_REVIEW flags. These are source-backed group-level candidate inputs, not individual trajectories or fitted results. Requirement links identify partial supporting evidence only: total/unbound basis, dose basis, formulation, sampling design and other modeling definitions remain unresolved. The source reports conflicting sample counts and a whole-lung figure-versus-Table S5 peak discrepancy; it limits this curve to an exploratory descriptive candidate pending reconciliation. Component identifiability and human prediction are unassessed.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: F0003:S3:T12 supplies three digitized mean concentrations, both Time (h) and Pixel time (h), SC single-dose information and animal characteristics. Total/unbound basis, formulation, dose basis, actual-versus-nominal interpretation of the two time columns, serial/destructive sampling design, BLQ/LLOQ metadata and missingness definitions are NOT_FOUND. Individual IDs and SD were not recovered according to A156. Marker labels do not establish animal identity. A159 does not define the statistic represented by +/-0.31 kg.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported definitions and sampling metadata for S22 Figure 2 panel A; preserve both time columns, group-level status and unknown fields. Refer any sufficiency requiring fitting to the animal PK module.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T12:A161 reports Methods n=3-4/time and caption n=3/time; the error-bar definition was not recovered. A156 reports no recovered SD. A158 explicitly describes +/-2 pixels as digitization tolerance, not biological SD or a confidence interval. These statements cannot establish a reconciled sample count or biological precision.
findings.needed_material: Independent source review of the methods, figure caption, sample-count applicability and error-bar definition. Retain both count statements and withhold selection of a reconciled count or variability measure.

findings.reason: Rabbit source discrepancies; status AMBIGUOUS; resolution_status OPEN; needed_at prepare; origin main:/missing_information/items/3. F0003:S3:T12:A163 identifies a discrepancy between the SC whole-lung Figure 2 peak and Table S5 Cmax, for S22 rabbit SC single 2 mg/kg. This page supplies whole-lung digitized mean observations but no Table S5 comparator value or its measurement definition. A160 separately reports plasma timing/count differences from the blood protocol; that plasma context must remain distinct from this whole-lung curve. Rabbit source values cannot be reconciled or selected without identifying the affected values and contexts.
findings.needed_material: Preserve MI004 unchanged as OPEN. At preparation, obtain authorized source evidence for both discrepant peak values, units, study, matrix, regimen and observed-versus-derived context, and record the applicable review decision without rescaling or silently reconciling values.

findings.reason: Additional public rabbit PMB concentration evidence; status NOT_FOUND; resolution_status OPEN; needed_at adequacy; origin main:/missing_information/items/1. The supplied project context reports that no further public rabbit PMB concentration data were found. This is a source-reported search availability limit, not proof of absence from all sources or unread attachment contents. This page provides a candidate rabbit curve but does not document the broader search scope. The reported limit must inform rabbit eligibility assessment.
findings.needed_material: Forward MI002 unchanged to adequacy and record the scope and consequences of the reported availability limit, with an explicit permitted outcome before the dependent adequacy decision.

findings.reason: Rabbit model-component support; status DEFERRED; resolution_status OPEN; needed_at pk; origin main:/missing_information/items/2. The SC011 component-identifiability assessment remains pending. F0003:S3:T12:A162 limits this source to an exploratory descriptive candidate pending source reconciliation and states no individual population PK or absolute SC CL without F. Availability of the mean curve does not establish an identifiable rabbit model component or authorize inclusion.
findings.needed_material: Forward MI003 unchanged to animal PK. Assess component identifiability under SC011 and record inclusion, exclusion or exploratory use with supporting evidence and rationale; retain the decision as pending until that assessment.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED: The source establishes rabbit, SC regimen, whole-lung matrix and exploratory descriptive context. It does not define the requested model curve or parameter outputs, a design-supported held-out prediction opportunity, or a justified systemic/pulmonary bridge. Whole-lung observations must remain distinct from plasma and ELF.
findings.needed_material: Define the intended rabbit whole-lung use and requested outputs separately from systemic and ELF objectives. Refer model-dependent adequacy and predictive evaluation to animal PK without forcing a pulmonary or multispecies model.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T12:A163 states No measured rabbit fu located. This is relevant to exposure-basis interpretation and later animal-to-human prediction, but it is a reported availability limitation rather than a binding measurement or evidence that no rabbit binding data exist anywhere.
findings.needed_material: Route the source-reported rabbit fu limitation to independent coverage and binding/translation review. Preserve whole-lung concentration basis as NOT_FOUND until supported; do not infer or apply an unbound conversion.
